conditions.raw: expanded responses, declaration-candidate semantics v1, archived original installed server
conditions.tree: compact responses on same historical v1 graph, current installed server
conditions.scip: compact responses plus native-symbol binding v2, current installed server

source_and_compiler_access: Identical public production sources, configuration, dependencies, compiler6.0.3 and original task/prompt. ERP excluded. No forced graph use or suppressed independent checking.
preparation: Existing frozen v1 database and private preparations reused, new v2 snapshot fully read back and database-enforced readonly after retained index recovery.
primary_metric: Total cumulative input+output tokens with exact source-reference quality guardrail
secondary_metrics: actual graph reads and payload text bytes
usage_granularity: Native CLI session terminal only; request-level allocation remains unavailable. Per-tool payload receipts retained.
limits: Two known tasks and two sessions per condition are descriptive development evidence.
No inference that a smaller response guarantees lower agent usage.

Raw and compact-v1 conditions share the exact original private context; original context mentions native_id in properties, while compact MCP documentation describes native_id at group level. This potential interface migration friction is retained rather than modifying frozen source/task contexts.
